plotSections.title: Activating the Fused Lantern-Staff at the Stronghold
bullets: Dana examines the fused lantern-staff and finds it a fairly typical magical item on superficial inspection; the frame of the lantern bears scrawled inscriptions in an archaic/arcane script.
Remembering that the last activation caused a vortex in the sky and blinded Gerk, Sylan retreats alone to his room in Langdale Stronghold to activate it, with Dana asking him to close the blinds.

Sylan sheathes his sword, holds the staff like a banner, and recites the activation incantation (a Green Lantern-style oath ending in "Lantern keeper's light"), closing his eyes on the fourth line as Ord did previously.

The whole stronghold goes 'noir': color drains slowly toward Sylan, shadows deepen, lights gain contrast, and the air turns chilly. Sylan perceives a hazy overlay of his world and another dimension, like a glimpse into his sword's spirit realm.

When Sylan opens his door, the frame collapses into impenetrable blackness and a howling, unrecognizable soul standing outside the door is sucked into him; only Sylan sees this. The others see Sylan as a semi-transparent, ghostly figure of shadows and hard silver lines.
Unlike the previous activation's mixed experience, this one is purely silent and 'dewy'.

plotSections.title: Spirit Residue on Walker's Helm
bullets: As Sylan approaches Walker, he sees wisps of whitish ectoplasm, gelatinous yet blowing like damp cloth, clinging to Walker's helm (dubbed 'soul goo' by Walker).
Walker sets the helm on the table and Sylan focuses the lantern's light on it, asking 'Who are you?'. The helm emits only incoherent wailing.

Sylan compares it to the creatures that wailed when he tried to take their souls in Nyx/Gilbrick; the DM says that was drastically different, though similar in the sense of interacting with the same kind of thing.
Dana freezes stock-still, staring at the helm.

chronologicalEvents: Dana inspects the lantern-staff and notes the arcane-script inscriptions on the lantern frame.
Sylan moves to his room to activate it, keeping his sword put away.
Sylan recites the lantern oath and closes his eyes; the stronghold turns grayscale and cold.
Opening his door, Sylan sucks in a howling soul; others see him as a silver spectral outline.
Sylan spots ectoplasm on Walker's helm; Walker places it on the table.
Sylan focuses the lantern on the helm and asks who it is; it only wails.
Dana freezes, staring at the helm.

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Fused lantern and staff that reveals the Ethereal Plane and draws nearby spirits when the active staff is held.
notes: Square medieval-style lantern on a cane/staff, open on all sides.
Archaic/arcane script inscriptions are scrawled along the lantern frame.
Activated by a four-line oath ending 'Lantern keeper's light'; Ord previously closed his eyes on activation.
Activation turns the surrounding area grayscale and cold, color drawn toward the holder; holder becomes a silver spectral outline seen by others.
Opening a door while active turned the frame into blackness and sucked a nearby soul into Sylan.
Can be focused on an object to reveal spirit residue and prompt a response.
quotesThemes: "In brightest day and darkest night... No evil shall escape my sight... Lantern keeper's light."

notes: Activated the lantern-staff alone in his room; absorbed a howling soul and appeared as a silver spectral figure.
Experience resembled glancing into his sword's spirit realm, but purely silent rather than mixed.
personality: Enthusiastic about the ghostly effects ('Love it. My job.')

Helm.existing: A helm Carlkin agreed to examine by appointment once a comrade returns.
notes: Wisps of whitish ectoplasm cling to it under the lantern's light.
Emits incoherent wailing when the lantern is focused on it.
openQuestions: Who or what is the wailing presence in the helm?
